biography:
I build momentum in complex, high-stakes environments—turning ambiguity into action and driving development strategies that unlock infrastructure growth. With over a decade of experience spanning corporate real estate, land acquisition, entitlement, energy planning, and financial operations, I lead cross-functional teams through every stage of the development lifecycle.I’ve helped lead the expansion of cloud infrastructure by closing 50+ land deals valued at $3B across strategic U.S. markets, delivering over 2.5 GW of capacity. I’ve executed PSAs, ground leases, and options; navigated zoning, mineral rights, and infrastructure constraints; and partnered with 25+ local jurisdictions to advance strategic projects. I’ve guided multi-phase sites through critical decisions, de-risked key investments, and delivered clean closings under tight timelines. I’m known for spotting issues early, asking sharp questions, and keeping projects moving with discipline and clarity.I’m recognized for clear communication, strong execution, and a collaborative leadership style. I’m motivated by the challenge of navigating complex negotiations and developing solutions that move projects—and teams—forward. I take a data-driven approach, value inclusive partnerships, and believe real progress comes from staying curious, learning quickly, and stepping up when it counts.Always open to connecting with professionals who share a passion for strategic real estate and problem-solving.
I'm a passionate Land Acquisition Manager at Microsoft, blending over 12 years of corporate real estate, finance, and project management experience to deliver strategic growth and infrastructure development. I thrive on leading complex projects and building strong, collaborative partnerships that drive success.

What truly motivates me is the challenge of navigating high-stakes negotiations and developing innovative solutions that propel projects forward. I'm known for my data-driven approach and my commitment to fostering teamwork that turns ambitious goals into reality.

Beyond my professional life, you'll often find me exploring new hiking trails, channeling the same determination and curiosity that fuels my work. I believe that growth comes from continuous learning and seizing opportunities to innovate.

Core Values: Strategic Thinking | Integrity | Collaboration | Growth Mindset

Always open to connecting and exchanging ideas with fellow professionals who share a passion for strategic real estate and problem-solving.
